script.base: Spread and total are not saved, so this flow is inferred only from form, not from a book number. SEA's offense has the explosives (J.Smith-Njigba 22 targets, 277 rec yds, 197 air yds in weeks 1-2) against a WAS defense allowing 13.1 YPA in the middle (10 att), 10.46 YPA on the right (26 att), 7 passes of 20+ on 61 attempts, and 4.64 rush YPC, while a Price/Wilson/Holani carry split (23/23/12) can run. WAS has been hunting shots (T.McLaurin 176 air yds for only 64 rec yds; S.Diggs 155 air; D.Brown 112 air) into a SEA defense that has allowed 0 of 66 passes of 20+, YPA of 4.89/4.5/4.0 by side, and 3.73 rush YPC. Most likely: SEA leads the yardage through JSN plus a committee run game, WAS stays short of explosives, and a second-half SEA lead adds runs without wiping out JSN's early targets.
script.flip1: WAS's 43% blitz keeps the game close even though SEA QB EPA vs blitz is still +0.38 (n=19); both teams throw, SEA RB rush yards stall, and a WAS 20+ yard shot finally shows up.
script.flip2: SEA gets up big and clock-kills: JSN routes stall after halftime, Price/Wilson carries rise, and WAS abandons the run for checkdowns so McLaurin's deep shots never develop.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both legs lost. JSN finished under 91.5 because the 277-yard two-game run regressed, WAS's middle 13.1 YPA is only 10 attempts of noise, they shaded the right side they actually throw at (26 att), and a multi-score lead let SEA run Price and Wilson and cut JSN under 6 targets. McLaurin cleared 42 because 176 air yards means the shots are scripted, SEA's 0-for-66 streak was a two-game sample that broke on one post, and SEA's 23% blitz left WAS in the +0.23 unblitzed EPA environment. That bomb case is why McLaurin is a lean, not a strong; it is not stronger than 32 yards per game plus a defense that has yet to allow the play. JSN's 22-of-47 listed-target share still beats the fade.
slip_story: Base-script stack only: SEA's WR1 attacks the WAS middle/right bleed (JSN recyds over 91.5) while WAS's unresolved deep shots stay blanketed (McLaurin recyds under 42). They win together if SEA controls explosives and still throws enough for JSN. They split on flip 1 (a close game where a WAS 20+ yard catch clears McLaurin).
